page_title: NIC 0-1 TOU | Nice v Toulouse 16/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+8' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
90+7' Nice take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90+4' A yellow card for a tackle by Hicham Boudaoui (Nice). Thomas Leonard doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
90+1' Substitution. Kojo Peprah walks off the pitch and Billal Brahimi (Nice) comes on as a substitute.
90' There will be a minimum of 8 min. of added time.
89' 0 - 1 Djibril Sidibe (Toulouse) finds himself in a very promising position after getting on the end of a brilliant pass and fires the ball inside the right post!
88' Antoine Mendy (Nice) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
87' Jeremie Boga (Nice) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
84' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Antoine Mendy (Nice) is thwarted and cleared to safety.

83' The corner evades everyone in the centre and ends up at the back post where Bernard Nguene (Nice) sends a wild header high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Toulouse.
83' The ball is out of play. Nice will have a chance to score from a corner.
82' Substitution. Dayann Methalie will be replaced by Rasmus Nicolaisen (Toulouse).
78' Bernard Nguene (Nice) sees a yellow card from Thomas Leonard after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
76' Substitution. Bernard Nguene (Nice) replaces Terem Moffi.
76' Franck Haise decides to make a substitution. Badredine Bouanani will be replaced by Sofiane Diop (Nice).
76' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Isak Jansson trots off the pitch and is replaced by Jeremie Boga (Nice).
76' That will be all from Tom Louchet who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Salis Abdul Samed (Nice).
76' Today's match ends for Frank Magri who will be replaced by Santiago Hidalgo (Toulouse).
75' A rebound falls kindly for Alexis Vossah (Toulouse), but his shot from the edge of the box flies high over bar. None too pretty! The ball goes out of play and Nice will have a goal kick.
75' Corner kick. Aron Donnum (Toulouse) is ready to send the ball into the box.

74' Dayann Methalie (Toulouse) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety. The ball goes behind for a corner. Toulouse will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
73' Warren Kamanzi (Toulouse) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
72' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
72' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) sends a chip pass into the box, but Guillaume Restes is quickest to intercept the ball.
71' Isak Jansson (Nice) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
70' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
68' The manager makes a subsitution with Alexis Vossah (Toulouse) coming on for Mario Sauer.
68' Here is a change. Noah Edjouma is going off and Carles Martinez gives the last tactical orders to Warren Kamanzi (Toulouse).
67' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
66' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) sends in a cross from the free-kick from the edge of the box. His effort is inaccurate and goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Toulouse.
65' The foul by Mario Sauer (Toulouse) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Thomas Leonard.
65' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) takes the corner with a short pass.
64' Antoine Mendy (Nice) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
63' Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.

62' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) attempts to threaten the goalkeeper from the free kick on the edge of the box. He produces a stunning blast which only flies inches over the crossbar. It could have been a beautiful goal! The ball goes out of play and Toulouse will have a goal kick.

61' Dayann Methalie (Toulouse) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Thomas Leonard with no other option than to blow for a foul. Nice get a free kick.
57' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Jonathan Clauss (Nice), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

56' Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Guillaume Restes makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the top left corner. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Nice.
56' Nice will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
55' Guillaume Restes (Toulouse) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
55' The game is interrupted now, Guillaume Restes (Toulouse) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
53' Isak Jansson (Nice) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Toulouse have a free kick.
53' Close! Jaydee Canvot (Toulouse) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nice.
51' Thomas Leonard shows a yellow card to Dayann Methalie (Toulouse), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
51' Charlie Cresswell (Toulouse) makes a strong challenge and Thomas Leonard blows for a foul. Free kick. Nice will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
50' Badredine Bouanani (Nice) gets into a great position in the box after a pass, but sends his shot just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Toulouse.
48' Charlie Cresswell (Toulouse) latched on to a lofted pass inside the box, but his header misses to the right of the target. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nice.
47' Kojo Peprah (Nice) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Thomas Leonard stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. Toulouse have a free kick.
47' Djibril Sidibe (Toulouse) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle. Nice will take a free kick.
46' Jaydee Canvot (Toulouse) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Thomas Leonard didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
46' Thomas Leonard blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' Badredine Bouanani (Nice) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
45+2' Jaydee Canvot (Toulouse) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nice.

45+1' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) is untouchable as he tricks his way into the box. His shot, though, lacks a little bit of accuracy and flies just over the bar. That would have been a great goal! The ball goes out of play and Nice will have a goal kick.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
43' Mario Sauer (Toulouse) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
43' The free kick is delivered by Djibril Sidibe (Toulouse) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
42' Isak Jansson (Nice) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Thomas Leonard blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Toulouse.
41' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Jaydee Canvot (Toulouse) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
38' Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
36' Frank Magri (Toulouse) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
36' Frank Magri (Toulouse) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

36' Charlie Cresswell (Toulouse) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team. There is a free kick near the sideline to Nice.
35' Toulouse have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
35' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Toulouse force their opponents to concede a corner.
34' Djibril Sidibe (Toulouse) makes a weak connection with the corner kick, and his close-range header is easily blocked.
34' Mario Sauer (Toulouse) steps up to send the ball in.
33' Noah Edjouma (Toulouse) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
30' Thomas Leonard interrupts the game. One of the players from Nice won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Toulouse will take a free kick near the side line.
29' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range low towards the middle of the goal, but Yehvann Diouf is equal to it and makes an easy save.
28' A player from Nice commits a rough challenge. Thomas Leonard blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Toulouse earn a free kick.
24' The referee blows for a cooling break.
22' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Nice, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
21' Djibril Sidibe (Toulouse) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Nice are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
21' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Toulouse, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
20' Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Thomas Leonard saw the whole situation. Toulouse are awarded a free kick.

19' Frank Magri (Toulouse) blows a huge opportunity! He latches on to a perfect cross from the wing into the penalty area, but sends a bullet header narrowly over the crossbar! The ball goes out of play and Nice will have a goal kick.
17' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Nice.

16' Melvin Bard (Nice) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play and Nice have been awarded a corner kick.
15' Thomas Leonard couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Noah Edjouma (Toulouse) and blew his whistle. Nice win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.

15' A cross by Jonathan Clauss (Nice) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Toulouse.
12' Isak Jansson (Nice) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
12' A quickly taken corner by Nice.

11' Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. The ball is out of play and Nice manage to earn a corner.
11' Melvin Bard (Nice) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
10' Badredine Bouanani (Nice) sends a chip pass into the box, but Guillaume Restes is quickest to intercept the ball.
8' Tom Louchet (Nice) sends a long ball in, but Guillaume Restes comfortably gathers the ball.
5' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Toulouse, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
5' Thomas Leonard blows his whistle after Tom Louchet (Nice) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Toulouse are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
1' Dayann Methalie (Toulouse) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Nice have a free kick.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Toulouse will have the kick-off.
Thomas Leonard will officiate today.
